answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Grading happens by lottery quorum: 7 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 69 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and one honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal. The seed that draws the panel is public and verifiable by anyone. The vine test is the live device, the bridge test is the locked stake, and the tundra test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
